<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nWhen a claims handler makes a reserve change that exceeds their personal authority, the system routes it to a single, specific approver. If that approver is unavailable and no delegate is assigned, the request becomes stuck in an approval queue. This halts all processing on the associated claim, causing unnecessary delays and backlogs.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Eight customer accounts** have reported this issue, representing a total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of £5,420,000.0 [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n- The problem has been raised through all three internal routes: Account Management (6 mentions), Support (7 mentions), and Sales (6 mentions) [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n- Specific affected accounts include Pendleford Motor Mutual (ARR £690,000.0), Wexmoor Motor (ARR £1,950,000.0), and Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR £1,250,000.0) [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n\n## Evidence\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual reported: \"We’ve had three handlers stuck for two days because their reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up... Claims are stalled because reserve changes beyond handler authority are stuck in an approver’s queue with no backup — approval waiting list is blocking everything.\" [i:279cabe81068b3d3].\n- Wexmoor Motor stated: \"Yes, it’s specifically when a reserve change exceeds handler limits — the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns.\" [i:30284f66470fac05] and \"Hi Bryn, we’re seeing claims stuck because reserve changes need approval but no one’s covering for the approver right now.\" [i:6c0c32d6e599691f].\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance said: \"When a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there — that reserve authorisation delay has caused real issues for us, especially when the approver’s out and no one’s covering.\" [i:47e4aac56f39b4d3] and \"Morning Bryn, we’ve got a couple of claims held up because the approver’s out and there’s no backup — the approval waiting list is piling up.\" [i:9daa7fe509e60a2f].\n- Ravensgill Insurance described the scenario where a reserve adjustment \"goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves.\" [i:655489deaf46b80c].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting reported delays because reserve adjustments \"just sit there until the one approver comes back — no backup, no delegation, and claims pile up.\" [i:94dd9ecf8c2990c2].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty reported: \"Hi Deryn, I’m Gellin from Saltmarsh Specialty — we’ve got a few claims held up because the approver’s out and no one’s covering their queue.\" [i:c50e7d9cace2b869] and \"it’s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list, and policyholders are starting to ask why payments are delayed.\" [i:e3f90adc3c0d1c88]. They also stated the delay \"halts payments and reporting.\" [i:fc3f5dbd98a536fe].\n- Sallowmere Motor reported: \"Some tasks are getting stuck in the queue.\" [i:65bfde9b620967c0].\n- Harrowfield Fleet Mutual stated: \"When a reserve exceeds authority and the approver’s out with no delegate, it just piles… it’s claims stalling until someone returns.\" [i:f50f773669fba30b].\n- There have been **0 renewals in the last 90 days** for the affected accounts [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n\n## Why now\nThe issue has been actively reported by customers across multiple routes since September 2026, with the most recent mentions in late October 2026 [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:655489deaf46b80c][i:9daa7fe509e60a2f]. The consistent feedback indicates the problem is a persistent operational bottleneck. Customers describe the situation as \"not sustainable\" [i:f6dc3676926959e6] and note that policyholders are beginning to notice the delays [i:e3f90adc3c0d1c88].\n",

response.content: {"critique": "All quoted customer statements match the cited insight texts verbatim (Pendleford, Wexmoor, Callowfield, Ravensgill, Holloway Reach, Saltmarsh, Harrowfield, Sallowmere, and the 'not sustainable' quote). The counts check out against the fact sheet: 8 accounts, ARR £5,420,000.0 total, route mentions of 6/7/6, and 0 renewals in 90 days, with the three named account ARRs (£690k, £1,950k, £1,250k) all accurate. The timeline claim (September to late October 2026) matches the insight dates, and the problem description is supported by the cited quotes, including Sallowmere's vague but accurately quoted 'Some tasks are getting stuck in the queue.' No overstated claims or ignored contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
